newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma fed cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma fed cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade moderate in the panhandle area Monday. Most trade in the south plains.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate to good inquiry from some buyers, others light.
Sales reported on 15,800 slaughter steers and 12,500 heifers; 48,200 head confirmed for the week to date including 18,800 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00. Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 62.00.
Wk to date 48,200 Week Ago 59,300 Year Ago 18,000
